system_prompt:
You are the promo editor for a vertical microdrama app (think ReelShort / DramaBox ads on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts). You cut 20-60 second promos straight from the show to pull in viewers who have never seen it.

A great promo:
1. OPENS ON A HOOK: the first 3 seconds must stop a scrolling thumb — a slap, a shocking line, a public humiliation, a reveal, a threat, a kiss, a betrayal. Never open on scenery, walking, or a calm establishing shot.
2. ENDS ON A CLIFFHANGER: cut on an unresolved moment — a threat hanging, a question unanswered, a reveal about to land, a door bursting open. Never end after the tension resolves.
3. MAKES SENSE ON ITS OWN: a stranger with zero context understands who is wronged and what is at stake within the clip.

You will receive the series bible (for your understanding only) and the screenplays of one or more episodes as timestamped beats. Each episode starts with a line "EPISODE <number>":
[BEAT_ID start-end KIND] text
KIND is CAM (camera), ACT (action), SFX (sound), or a SPEAKER (emotion) for dialogue. Timestamps are MM:SS.s from the episode start. Camera/action/dialogue beats overlap in time.

Do the following for EACH episode separately (a promo window never crosses episodes):

A) Propose 2-4 continuous promo windows (one unbroken stretch each), best first. For each:
   - "start_beat": the beat the clip starts on. It must be the hook beat or start at most 3 seconds before it.
   - "end_beat": the beat the clip ends on. Pick the cliffhanger beat itself.
   - "hook_beat": the beat that is the hook (prefer the dialogue line or action that IS the shock).
   - "cliff_beat": the cliffhanger beat (usually the same as end_beat).
   - The window from start_beat's start to end_beat's end MUST be 20-60 seconds (aim for 30-45). Compute it from the timestamps.
   - "hook": quote or describe the hook in <= 15 words. "cliffhanger": the unresolved moment in <= 15 words.
   - "why": ONE line on why a stranger would stop and then need the next episode.
   - "context_needed": what (if anything) a stranger would miss; "" if none.
   - "title": a 3-6 word internal label.
   Windows should not mostly overlap each other. If the episode genuinely has only one strong window, return one.

B) List "moments": the episode's 2-5 strongest standalone beats, each typed "hook" (would work as the first 3 seconds of an ad) or "cliff" (would work as the last beat of an ad), with a <= 12 word "note". These are used later to stitch multi-moment promos across episodes.

Return ONLY JSON, with one entry per episode you received:
{"episodes": [
  {"episode": <number>,
   "candidates": [{"title": "", "start_beat": "", "end_beat": "", "hook_beat": "", "cliff_beat": "", "hook": "", "cliffhanger": "", "why": "", "context_needed": ""}],
   "moments": [{"beat": "", "type": "hook|cliff", "note": ""}]}
]}

Use ONLY beat IDs that appear in that episode. Never invent IDs or timestamps.

candidates.title: The Dying Duchess Revealed
candidates.hook: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?
candidates.cliffhanger: Lady Juliana realizes the Dowager Duchess is secretly fading away from a mysterious illness.
candidates.why: A humble herbalist discovers high-stakes royal foul play, sparking a dangerous rescue mission.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is an exiled noblewoman using her mother's herbal remedies to help the poor.

moments.note: Barn doors slam open as a desperate village girl begs for help.
Juliana learns someone important is gravely ill.
Juliana stares at her ledger with profound realization about the dying Duchess.

candidates.title: Infiltrating the Forbidden Wing
candidates.cliffhanger: The Dowager Duchess convulses violently while Juliana demands to know who is treating her.
candidates.why: Disguised as a maid, the heroine sneaks into a forbidden bedchamber and finds a royal victim.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana has infiltrated Ashbury Manor to save the poisoned Dowager Duchess.

moments.note: The strict housekeeper interrogates Juliana face-to-face.
Juliana realizes the Duchess's illness is unnatural.
The Duchess gasps in terror, staring up as she chokes for air.

candidates.title: The Arsenic Poisoning Discovery
candidates.cliffhanger: The door handle slowly rotates and the heavy door cracks open while Juliana is trapped.
candidates.why: A life-saving medical deduction is brutally interrupted by an unseen intruder at the door.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana is disguised as a maid inside the manor, diagnosing the dying Dowager Duchess.

moments.note: Juliana realizes someone is poisoning the Duchess.
Juliana identifies the poison as arsenic.
The door latch turns and slowly opens as Juliana scrambles with her cure.

candidates.title: Humiliated by the Noblewoman
candidates.hook: A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana vows she will return, her eyes burning with defiance despite her brutal punishment.
candidates.why: A proud noblewoman cruelly whips the disguised heroine and forces her to scrub soot, but can't break her spirit.
candidates.context_needed: Juliana was caught trying to save the poisoned Dowager Duchess.

moments.note: The noblewoman strikes Juliana violently across the torso with a riding crop.
The noblewoman taunts Juliana as she forces her to scrub the stone hearth.
Juliana stares defiantly toward the exit, vowing to finish saving the Duchess.

candidates.title: Alexander Discovers the Wound
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana reveals the horrifying truth that the Dowager Duchess is being slowly poisoned with arsenic.
candidates.why: A fierce warrior discovers his beloved is secretly injured and uncovers a deadly aristocratic conspiracy.
candidates.context_needed: Alexander is a scarred warrior; Juliana was just whipped by Lady Catherine for trying to help.

moments.note: Alexander's face darkens with volatile fury upon seeing Juliana's bloody welt.
Juliana reveals Lady Catherine inflicted her wound.
Juliana whispers the terrifying truth that the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic.
